label_review.notes: Curated seed labels only. The corpus intentionally remains below the default ten-positive/ten-negative graduation floor while real Artifacture captures and human adjudication are added.

fire.title: Heading clipped at the viewport edge
fire.truth_excerpt: The full heading is authored as “Operational evidence architecture.”
fire.adjudication_notes: The final word is cut mid-character at the right edge; no ellipsis or disclosure control is present.

clean.title: Long heading wraps intentionally
clean.truth_excerpt: The heading may wrap to preserve every authored word.
clean.adjudication_notes: The two-line wrap is intentional and every character remains visible; line wrapping is not clipping.

fire.title: Audit label chopped inside a fixed cell
fire.truth_excerpt: The complete queue name is required to distinguish it from the frontier queue.
fire.adjudication_notes: The label is visibly chopped inside an overflow-hidden cell and cannot be recovered from adjacent content.

clean.title: Dense expert table scrolls without truncating labels
clean.truth_excerpt: Dense expert surfaces are allowed when their labels remain available.
clean.adjudication_notes: The table is intentionally dense, but the label is complete and the horizontal overflow affordance is visible.

fire.title: Three primary treatments compete
fire.truth_excerpt: The slide’s narrative job is to explain the routing topology.
fire.adjudication_notes: A huge title, saturated diagram, and equally large KPI row all demand first attention, leaving no single focal point.

clean.title: Dense evidence supports one dominant diagram
clean.truth_excerpt: The router is the claim; supporting metrics may remain subordinate.
clean.adjudication_notes: The surface contains many expert details, but scale and contrast clearly make the router diagram the single focal element.

fire.title: Tiny diagram floats in unexplained space
fire.truth_excerpt: The three-stage route is the full content of the slide.
fire.adjudication_notes: The diagram occupies a small corner while most of the canvas is unexplained blank space, making the content feel missing.

clean.title: Authored breathing room frames a short claim
clean.truth_excerpt: The brief calls for a quiet transition slide with one compact route.
clean.adjudication_notes: The blank area is deliberately balanced around a centered claim and does not resemble a collapsed or missing region.

fire.title: Collapsed third column leaves accidental dead space
fire.truth_excerpt: All three peer stages have content in the source brief.
fire.adjudication_notes: The third stage collapses to a tiny block and leaves a large blank region that reads as missing content.

clean.title: Evidence rail intentionally leaves reading space
clean.truth_excerpt: The composition is an editorial 70/30 narrative and evidence split.
clean.adjudication_notes: The narrow evidence rail and open lower area are authored hierarchy, not a missing peer column.

fire.title: Equivalent peer tracks drift in width
fire.truth_excerpt: The three stages are declared as equivalent review tracks.
fire.adjudication_notes: The middle track is inexplicably narrower and divider positions do not align across otherwise equivalent regions.

clean.title: Equivalent peer tracks stay balanced
clean.truth_excerpt: The three stages are declared as equivalent review tracks.
clean.adjudication_notes: All three peer tracks use equal widths and aligned dividers, providing the direct clean counterpart for the drift case.

fire.title: Peer row baselines do not align
fire.truth_excerpt: Rows represent direct before/after counterparts.
fire.adjudication_notes: Corresponding row dividers drift vertically, undermining the declared one-to-one comparison.

clean.title: Peer row baselines align
clean.truth_excerpt: Rows represent direct before/after counterparts.
clean.adjudication_notes: Corresponding dividers and content baselines align across all three peer tracks.

fire.title: Controls crowd the primary claim
fire.truth_excerpt: The page title and selected policy are the primary content.
fire.adjudication_notes: Large controls surround and visually overpower the title, producing several competing focal targets.

clean.title: Compact expert controls remain subordinate
clean.truth_excerpt: Frequent operators need all controls available without losing the page claim.
clean.adjudication_notes: The surface is dense by design, but compact chrome remains subordinate to one clear title and active policy.

label_review.notes: Synthetic seed evidence only. A named human must inspect every rendered fire/clean pair before this family can contribute to qualification; production-shaped state groups are also required before graduation.

fire.title: Warning decoration is the only visible failure
fire.visible_text: Good and bad examples must earn their labels
fire.truth_excerpt: The negative example is supposed to demonstrate broken symmetry.
fire.adjudication_notes: Both examples have equal tracks and baselines; only the warning rule and caption claim the right example is bad.

clean.title: Negative example visibly breaks symmetry
clean.visible_text: Good and bad examples must earn their labels
clean.truth_excerpt: The negative example is supposed to demonstrate broken symmetry.
clean.adjudication_notes: The negative example has unequal tracks and a displaced baseline before its caption is read.

fire.title: Annotation for B sits beneath A
fire.visible_text: Annotations should map directly to evidence
fire.truth_excerpt: The annotation describes Example B.
fire.adjudication_notes: The annotation is aligned under Example A without a connector, so proximity assigns it to the wrong evidence.

clean.title: Annotation shares Example B's column
clean.visible_text: Annotations should map directly to evidence
clean.truth_excerpt: The annotation describes Example B.
clean.adjudication_notes: The annotation is directly aligned with the evidence it names.

fire.title: Three regions repeat one conclusion
fire.visible_text: One claim should have one clear reading path
fire.truth_excerpt: The slide only needs to explain one bounded decision.
fire.adjudication_notes: Explanation, checklist, and return contract repeat the same conclusion with equal visual weight.

clean.title: One decision leads and evidence supports it
clean.visible_text: One claim should have one clear reading path
clean.truth_excerpt: The slide only needs to explain one bounded decision.
clean.adjudication_notes: The decision is dominant and the smaller evidence region advances rather than repeats it.

fire.title: Ornamental metadata repeats the deck context
fire.visible_text: Visible metadata must help the audience understand or act
fire.truth_excerpt: The slide already shows the patient case and probabilistic relationship.
fire.adjudication_notes: The lower-corner strip repeats the case name and generic descriptors without adding navigation, provenance, a required notice, state, or comparison data.

clean.title: A source footer supports evaluation of the claim
clean.visible_text: Visible metadata must help the audience understand or act
clean.truth_excerpt: The audience needs the pathway citation to evaluate the clinical claim.
clean.adjudication_notes: The footer gives a specific source and section that the audience can use.

fire.title: Three lessons reuse the same card pair
fire.truth_excerpt: The adjacent slides teach three different review relationships.
fire.adjudication_notes: All three frames use the same equal good/bad card pair, making distinct relationships look mechanically identical.

clean.title: Adjacent lessons use fitting structures
clean.truth_excerpt: The adjacent slides teach comparison, sequence, and primary-versus-supporting hierarchy.
clean.adjudication_notes: The frames vary their structure because their relationships differ while retaining one visual system.

fire.title: Click-in obscures context and clips its last line
fire.visible_text: Click-ins need their own full-frame review
fire.truth_excerpt: The click-in should add evidence while preserving context and dismissal controls.
fire.adjudication_notes: The oversized overlay covers the base evidence and trigger while its final line escapes the visible frame.

clean.title: Click-in uses reserved space and stays dismissible
clean.visible_text: Click-ins need their own full-frame review
clean.truth_excerpt: The click-in should add evidence while preserving context and dismissal controls.
clean.adjudication_notes: The overlay occupies a separate lane, keeps the base anchor visible, and contains its close control and copy.

region.label: Example labelled as a passing repeated-track layout

fire.title: Pass example has an underweighted middle track
fire.visible_text: Input · Router · Output should read as equal peers
fire.truth_excerpt: The example is labelled positive because all three regions are direct peers.
fire.adjudication_notes: The narrow middle track visibly contradicts the example's positive label and peer relationship.

clean.title: Pass example gives direct peers equal tracks
clean.visible_text: Input · Router · Output should read as equal peers
clean.truth_excerpt: The example is labelled positive because all three regions are direct peers.
clean.adjudication_notes: The three direct peers have equal widths and aligned baselines, so the positive label is visually supported.

fire.title: Swimlanes and containment conflict
fire.truth_excerpt: The content describes one request flow.
fire.adjudication_notes: Half the figure uses lanes while the other half uses nested containment for the same relation.

clean.title: One flow grammar with a highlighted boundary
clean.truth_excerpt: The boundary denotes deployment ownership inside one request flow.
clean.adjudication_notes: A boundary annotation does not create a second diagram type; connectors and nodes retain one stable grammar.

fire.title: One-day and six-month gaps look equal
fire.truth_excerpt: The milestones occur after one day and then roughly six months.
fire.adjudication_notes: Equal visual spacing materially misrepresents the stated time intervals.

clean.title: Compressed timeline explicitly marks a break
clean.truth_excerpt: The timeline is compressed and must disclose the discontinuity.
clean.adjudication_notes: A visible axis break and label make the non-linear spacing explicit rather than deceptively proportional.

fire.title: Near-equal bars represent a fourfold difference
fire.truth_excerpt: The second value is four times the first.
fire.adjudication_notes: The bars differ only slightly in length, visually erasing a load-bearing fourfold ratio.

clean.title: Scaled bars preserve the fourfold relation
clean.truth_excerpt: The second value is four times the first.
clean.adjudication_notes: The bar lengths preserve the load-bearing ratio and agree with their explicit value labels.

fire.title: Legend names an absent cache category
fire.truth_excerpt: Only API and Store categories are drawn.
fire.adjudication_notes: The legend includes Cache even though no corresponding mark exists in the figure.

clean.title: Muted category still appears in the figure
clean.truth_excerpt: Cache is present but intentionally de-emphasized because it is inactive.
clean.adjudication_notes: Every legend category has a plotted counterpart; low emphasis is not absence.

fire.title: Decision nodes lack a legend entry
fire.truth_excerpt: Diamonds encode decisions and rectangles encode services.
fire.adjudication_notes: A distinct load-bearing diamond category is used repeatedly but the legend never defines it.

clean.title: Annotation callout does not need a legend category
clean.truth_excerpt: The lone dashed note is explanatory annotation, not a data category.
clean.adjudication_notes: A conventional one-off annotation is self-labelled and does not create an unexplained visual category.

fire.title: Three independent bullets are boxed and arrowed
fire.truth_excerpt: The brief lists three independent qualities with no sequence or relationship.
fire.adjudication_notes: Boxes and arrows add a false flow while conveying no information beyond a short list.

clean.title: Three nodes expose a real dependency
clean.truth_excerpt: Graduation requires adjudication, which requires captured observations.
clean.adjudication_notes: The connectors encode necessary dependency and therefore add information beyond the labels.

fire.title: Two unrelated nodes claim equal dominance
fire.truth_excerpt: The narrative job is to explain policy routing.
fire.adjudication_notes: Two saturated oversized nodes compete even though only the router is load-bearing to the claim.

clean.title: Two endpoints frame one dominant transformation
clean.truth_excerpt: The policy router is the transformation under explanation.
clean.adjudication_notes: Endpoints remain visible but the central router is unmistakably dominant.

fire.title: Hard-coded dark panel leaks into light mode
fire.truth_excerpt: Both screenshots should express the same preset in their respective mode.
fire.adjudication_notes: One panel remains dark only in the light screenshot and its text fails to invert with the rest of the preset.

clean.title: Dark data surface is intentional in both modes
clean.truth_excerpt: The embedded terminal is explicitly a dark simulated surface in either page mode.
clean.adjudication_notes: The stable dark terminal is content semantics, not a failed page-mode inversion, and its own text remains readable.

fire.title: Icons disappear against the dark surface
fire.truth_excerpt: Icon and label meaning must remain visible in both modes.
fire.adjudication_notes: The dark screenshot retains a dark icon fill, making load-bearing symbols effectively invisible.

clean.title: Decorative watermark fades in dark mode
clean.truth_excerpt: The watermark is non-semantic decoration and may be quiet.
clean.adjudication_notes: All load-bearing icons and text remain visible; only a deliberately non-semantic watermark loses prominence.

fire.title: Orange tints an entire status section
fire.truth_excerpt: Mono-Industrial reserves color for specific values with status meaning.
fire.adjudication_notes: Orange colors a container and heading without representing an actual warning value.

clean.title: One warning value carries orange
clean.truth_excerpt: Three delayed items are a measured warning state.
clean.adjudication_notes: Color is scoped to the precise delayed count and therefore conveys genuine value semantics.

fire.title: Several unrelated elements break the grid
fire.truth_excerpt: Emphasis must help the reader distinguish the decision from supporting evidence.
fire.adjudication_notes: Unrelated rotations and size changes compete for attention without explaining the content.

clean.title: The decision is visibly emphasized
clean.truth_excerpt: The decision should be distinguishable from its supporting evidence.
clean.adjudication_notes: The larger decision text establishes hierarchy while the supporting content remains aligned and readable.

fire.title: Five equally loud emphasis layers
fire.truth_excerpt: The reader must be able to distinguish headings, evidence, and supporting labels.
fire.adjudication_notes: Near-equal weights and sizes compete for attention and obscure the reading order.

clean.title: Heading and supporting content are distinguishable
clean.truth_excerpt: Dense content needs distinguishable headings and supporting detail.
clean.adjudication_notes: The heading, sections, and labels have distinct visual roles. No fixed number of emphasis levels is required.

fire.title: Red accent is a decorative underline
fire.truth_excerpt: Nothing red is reserved for urgent, destructive, or error meaning.
fire.adjudication_notes: The single red use merely decorates a neutral heading and communicates no status.

clean.title: Red marks a destructive reset action
clean.truth_excerpt: Resetting the policy is destructive and requires explicit warning.
clean.adjudication_notes: The red accent is scoped to a genuine destructive action rather than used as ornament.

fire.title: Three cards independently escape the grid
fire.truth_excerpt: Alignment and spacing should make relationships between sections clear.
fire.adjudication_notes: Arbitrary offsets interrupt alignment without explaining a relationship or priority.

clean.title: The review section spans the space it needs
clean.truth_excerpt: A section may span tracks when the content requires more space.
clean.adjudication_notes: The review section has enough room while its position remains consistent with the reading order.

fire.title: Glossy rounded demo conflicts with flat host
fire.truth_excerpt: The host preset uses flat square surfaces and restrained borders.
fire.adjudication_notes: Large radius, glow, and heavy shadow make the demo feel pasted onto a visibly different design system.

clean.title: Functional browser chrome remains distinct
clean.truth_excerpt: The demo needs a minimal frame to communicate that it is interactive.
clean.adjudication_notes: The frame is functionally necessary and still matches the host’s radius, border, color, and caption treatment.

fire.title: Four cards hide the selection policy
fire.truth_excerpt: A policy router assigns cases to distinct review queues with different entry rules.
fire.adjudication_notes: Equal cards name destinations but omit the router, mandatory path, sampling rule, and deduplication.

clean.title: Router exposes queue selection and overlap handling
clean.truth_excerpt: A policy router assigns cases to distinct review queues with different entry rules.
clean.adjudication_notes: The composition shows the universal gate, routing rules, separate queues, and deduplication path.

fire.title: Feedback loop is drawn as a one-way pipeline
fire.truth_excerpt: Deployment outcomes feed the next calibration cycle.
fire.adjudication_notes: The one-way pipeline omits the load-bearing return path and misstates the process as terminal.

clean.title: Feedback path returns outcomes to calibration
clean.truth_excerpt: Deployment outcomes feed the next calibration cycle.
clean.adjudication_notes: The return connector and its label make the iterative causal structure reconstructable.

fire.title: Evidence cards omit source-to-decision paths
fire.truth_excerpt: The viewer must reconstruct which source supports each decision claim.
fire.adjudication_notes: Grouped cards contain the right nouns but no connectors or identifiers preserve provenance.

clean.title: Trace IDs connect sources through findings to decisions
clean.truth_excerpt: The viewer must reconstruct which source supports each decision claim.
clean.adjudication_notes: Stable identifiers and connectors preserve the evidence path without requiring presenter narration.

fire.title: Statuses appear without allowed transitions
fire.truth_excerpt: Cases can escalate from pending or reviewed, but only reviewed cases can close.
fire.adjudication_notes: Status badges expose no transition rules and cannot communicate the allowed state changes.

clean.title: State machine exposes guarded transitions
clean.truth_excerpt: Cases can escalate from pending or reviewed, but only reviewed cases can close.
clean.adjudication_notes: Directed and labelled transitions make the guarded state changes reconstructable.

fire.title: Equation overstates a qualitative comparison
fire.truth_excerpt: The source offers only a qualitative preference and supplies no costs or multiplicative relationship.
fire.adjudication_notes: The equation asserts a measured quantitative relationship that the source does not establish.

clean.title: Equation faithfully expresses a measured comparison
clean.truth_excerpt: The source defines review count n and measured review and verification costs using this exact inequality.
clean.adjudication_notes: The same equation is legitimate because every term and relationship is supported by the supplied source evidence.

fire.title: Interactive workflow is flattened into generic cards
fire.truth_excerpt: The clinician’s interaction among evidence, hypotheses, and actions is the claim.
fire.adjudication_notes: Three generic cards omit selection, comparison, and action state that define the workflow.

clean.title: Simulated workspace exposes the interaction
clean.truth_excerpt: The clinician’s interaction among evidence, hypotheses, and actions is the claim.
clean.adjudication_notes: The simulated surface faithfully exposes selection state, linked evidence, and available next actions.

fire.title: Independent options are numbered and arrowed
fire.truth_excerpt: Users may choose Explore, Compare, or Export in any order.
fire.adjudication_notes: Numbers and arrows imply a required progression that the source explicitly does not establish.

clean.title: Numbered workflow follows real dependencies
clean.truth_excerpt: Adjudication requires captured observations; graduation requires adjudication.
clean.adjudication_notes: Every number and connector corresponds to a documented dependency and real order.

fire.title: Static mockup claims 87 percent confidence
fire.truth_excerpt: No calculation, measurement, or source supplies a confidence value.
fire.adjudication_notes: The meter looks measured and live even though the artifact has no supporting state.

clean.title: Confidence derives from displayed test results
clean.truth_excerpt: The value is calculated from 87 passing checks out of 100 and links to the method.
clean.adjudication_notes: The measured value and its derivation are both visible, so the state implication is supported.

fire.title: Decorative progress bar implies task completion
fire.truth_excerpt: The page performs no analysis and tracks no progress.
fire.adjudication_notes: A filled meter and percentage imply active measured completion without any underlying task.

clean.title: Deck progress reflects actual navigation
clean.truth_excerpt: The viewer is currently on slide seven of ten.
clean.adjudication_notes: The progress treatment is directly bound to real navigation state and accurately calculated.

fire.title: Citation marker has no source target
fire.truth_excerpt: The artifact supplies no source list, footnote, or link target.
fire.adjudication_notes: The bracketed marker conventionally implies traceable evidence that the artifact cannot provide.

clean.title: Footnote marker resolves to a supplied source
clean.truth_excerpt: Footnote seven names the study, publication date, and resolvable URL.
clean.adjudication_notes: The provenance cue is backed by a concrete source target in the artifact.

fire.title: Decorative source strip invents freshness
fire.truth_excerpt: The content is static prose with no source feed or retrieval time.
fire.adjudication_notes: Source and timestamp chrome imply a live traceable feed that the artifact does not possess.

clean.title: Snapshot timestamp identifies a real retrieval
clean.truth_excerpt: Dataset version 18 was retrieved at 2026-07-25 10:30Z and is bundled with the report.
clean.adjudication_notes: The timestamp and version accurately identify a supplied snapshot rather than manufacturing freshness.

fire.title: Fake terminal reports successful deployment
fire.truth_excerpt: The artifact never ran a deployment command and has no execution result.
fire.adjudication_notes: Terminal chrome and SUCCESS output imply an executed command and measured state that never occurred.

clean.title: Terminal is explicitly labelled as an example
clean.truth_excerpt: The panel documents a command example and makes no claim that it ran.
clean.adjudication_notes: The example label and dry-run wording prevent a reasonable viewer from inferring live execution state.

fire.title: Parallel choices are connected as a pipeline
fire.truth_excerpt: PDF, Slides, and Web are independent export formats selected one at a time.
fire.adjudication_notes: Directional arrows falsely imply transformation from one export format into the next.

clean.title: Arrows reflect a real deployment sequence
clean.truth_excerpt: The documented migration moves from self-hosted to managed operation and then to a hybrid steady state.
clean.adjudication_notes: The directional sequence is supported by the supplied migration plan rather than invented from parallel choices.
